persian_edits.before: هر دو از فعل ثلاثی «سَبَّ يَسُبُّ» هستند. صورت نخست در ساخت نهی آمده و صورت دوم پیامد احتمالی همان رفتار را بیان می‌کند.
persian_edits.after: هر دو از فعل ثلاثی «سَبَّ يَسُبُّ» هستند. «تَسُبُّوا» پس از «لا»ی نهی مجزوم است؛ «فَيَسُبُّوا» پس از فاءِ سببیه، با «أن» مقدر منصوب است و پیامدِ رفتارِ نهی‌شده را بیان می‌کند. در هر دو صورت، حذف نون علامت اعراب است.

persian_edits.before: این نکته در سیاق آیات ۶:۱۰۶ و ۶:۱۰۷ نیز معنا پیدا می‌کند. در آنجا فرمان پیروی از وحی و روی گرداندن از مشرکان آمده و روشن شده است که پیامبر نگهبان و کارگزار آنان قرار داده نشده است.
persian_edits.after: این نکته در سیاق آیات انعام ۶:۱۰۶ و انعام ۶:۱۰۷ نیز معنا پیدا می‌کند. در آنجا فرمان پیروی از وحی و روی گرداندن از مشرکان آمده و روشن شده است که پیامبر نگهبان و کارگزار آنان قرار داده نشده است.

They invoke: what others call upon in worship apart from God.
Apart from: in the expression min dūni Allāhi.
In transgression: describing the insulting conduct.
Without: introducing the absence of knowledge.
Knowledge: the awareness absent from that insulting conduct.
We have made attractive: each community’s conduct in its own eyes.
For every: encompassing the communities being discussed.
Community: a human group with shared conduct and orientation.
Their conduct: the deeds of that community.
Their Lord: the one to whom they return.
Their return: their returning to the Lord.
Then He informs them: concerning what they used to do.
They used to: with the following verb, expressing their past conduct.
They did: the deeds of which they will be informed.
We empowered: providing him the ability and means to act in the land.
The land: the setting of his empowerment and action.

Every: expressing breadth of resources in the context of his undertaking.
Thing: that for which a means of access was given.
So he followed: pursuing a route for his journey.
He followed: pursuing the next route.
He followed: pursuing another route.
Is: within the conditional description of the person.
Supposes: the assumption that divine help will not come.
Help him: the pronoun’s referent is discussed in interpretations of the verse.
This world: present life, contrasted with the Hereafter.
And the Hereafter: the life to come, alongside this world.

The sky: the direction of the rope, interpreted as sky or ceiling in different readings.
Let him cut: the object of cutting differs across interpretations of the sentence.

His conduct: Pharaoh’s deeds.
